prompt:

Header text verbatim: "ett knä". Smaller English meaning verbatim: "knee".
Scene: A seated adult bending one leg, a subtle gold ring highlighting the knee joint, with the whole bent leg clearly visible and anatomically natural.
Memory-link caption verbatim: "knä resembles knee; picture the joint in the middle of the leg.".
Swedish example in bottom strip verbatim: "Jag böjer mitt knä.".
Teach only the sense shown by this sentence. Print only the supplied heading, English meaning, memory caption and Swedish example. If the caption contains a sound/spelling association, mark it with the small exact label "Memory trick".
styleReference: Established Swedish vocabulary card layout, described in the prompt; no image supplied to generation.
